META_DESCRIPTION: Track every banking fee, account charge, and financial service cost. FincWin's Banking envelope keeps your financial infrastructure lean and visible.
HERO_SUB: Banking fees, account charges, wire transfers — they're small, they're forgettable, and they quietly add up every single month. FincWin keeps your banking costs in check.
PAIN_ITEM_1_H3: The monthly maintenance fee you forgot about
PAIN_ITEM_1_P: $12/month doesn't sound like much. Until you realise you've paid $144 this year for an account you barely use — and never noticed it leaving.
PAIN_ITEM_2_H3: ATM fees that vanish into thin air
PAIN_ITEM_2_P: You withdraw $60 cash and pay $3.50 in fees. You do that eight times and you've lost $28 — the cost of a decent dinner you never ordered.
PAIN_ITEM_3_H3: Wire transfer costs no one warned you about
PAIN_ITEM_3_P: You send money internationally and $25–$45 disappears in transfer fees. If you do that quarterly, that's up to $180 a year going nowhere.
FEATURES_H2:
The Banking envelope
makes fees impossible to ignore.
CARD_1_P: Set a cap for your total banking costs each month. The moment fees start creeping toward your limit, FincWin shows you — before you go over.
CARD_2_P: Log your monthly account fees as recurring expenses and see them automatically appear in your envelope every cycle. No surprises, ever.
CARD_3_P: See if your banking costs are creeping upward. A new fee added quietly in March shows up clearly in your June trend chart. Notice it. Act on it.
